source.note: The axiom_inputs mapping this cross-engine panel suite feeds the composed tariff spine (the exact keys under us:policies/cbp/us-tariff-duty/composition#input.*), plus the per-unit probe date. Copied by hand from the pinned file; the sha256 lets any reviewer re-derive it.

shipment_value.constraint: equal to customs_value (documented P2 assumption; no separate shipment-value margin exists)

country_of_origin.format: two uppercase letters: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, or the Census Schedule C conventions GZ/WE/KV carried through the vendored bridge

is_postal_shipment.constraint: uniformly False (documented P2 gap: no public postal split at the margin grain)

evaluation_date.axiom_input: per-unit probe date (the suite evaluates each unit as of a date)
